/* Brands Section */
.brands {
    background-color: var(--light);
}

.brands-slider {
    display: flex;
    overflow-x: auto; /* Changed from hidden to auto for manual scrolling */
    position: relative;
    padding: 20px 0;
    cursor: grab;
    scrollbar-width: none; /* Hide scrollbar for Firefox */
    -ms-overflow-style: none; /* Hide scrollbar for IE/Edge */
}

.brands-slider::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none; /* Hide scrollbar for Webkit browsers */
}

.brands-slider.grabbing {
    cursor: grabbing;
    scroll-snap-type: none;
}

.brands-track {
    display: flex;
    animation: scroll 10s linear infinite;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
}

.brand-item {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 200px;
    margin: 0 30px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background-color: white;
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
    scroll-snap-align: start;
}

.brand-item img {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    filter: grayscale(0%);
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.brand-item:hover img {
    filter: grayscale(100%);
}

@keyframes scroll {
    0% {
        transform: translateX(0);
    }
    100% {
        transform: translateX(-50%);
    }
}

/* Override reduced-motion */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .brands-track {
        animation-duration: 10s !important;
        animation-iteration-count: infinite !important;
    }
}

/* Pause animation on hover and when manually scrolling */
.brands-slider:hover .brands-track,
.brands-slider.manual-scroll .brands-track {
    animation-play-state: paused;
}
